info.name: mdFlow API
info.description:
Postman collection for the mdFlow Public API. All endpoints from the OpenAPI spec at https://docs.mdflow.xyz/openapi.json.

Stream scoping: both the `stream` query parameter and the `X-Stream-ID` request header are accepted by the API and return identical results. This collection uses the `stream` query param (where applicable) per the documented variable scheme. The `{{API_KEY}}` variable must be set — set it in the collection or environment.

variable.description: Your mdFlow API key (Settings → API Keys). Set this before sending any request.
A known-safe read-only item ID (the Startup Archive area). Used as the default path param for /items/{id} and /tree/{id}.

item.name: GET health
item.description: Public liveness check — no authentication required. Returns {status: ok} if the service is up.

item.name: GET me
item.description: Echo the authenticated API key — returns the userId and key metadata. Useful for verifying your key is valid and seeing which streams it can access.

item.name: GET streams
item.description: List all streams the authenticated key is allowed to access. Returns id, name, type (activity/knowledge), color, and item count for each stream.

item.name: GET items/roots
item.description: List non-archived root-level items in the active stream — projects (activity streams) or areas (knowledge streams).

header.description: Alternative to stream query param. Uncomment if preferred.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: GET items
item.description: List items in the active stream with optional filters. Supports pagination via limit/offset.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.
Comma-separated status values, e.g. 'todo,in-progress' (activity) or 'living' (knowledge).
Item type: task, project, area, or note.
Priority: high, medium, low, or none.
Filter to children of this parent item ID.
Exact YYYY-MM-DD, or one of: today, overdue, this-week.
Exact YYYY-MM-DD, or 'today'.
Comma-separated tags; all must match.
Max items to return.
Pagination offset.
Set to true to include the full markdown body in each item.

item.name: GET items/{id}
item.description: Fetch a single item by ID, including its full markdown body.

variable.description: Item ID. Defaults to SAMPLE_ITEM_ID (Startup Archive area — safe read-only).

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: POST items
item.description: Create a new item in the active stream. Only 'title' is required; all other fields are optional.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "New note from Postman",
  "type": "note",
  "status": "draft",
  "body": "## Summary\n\nCreated via the mdFlow REST API.",
  "tags": ["postman", "test"],
  "parent": "{{SAMPLE_ITEM_ID}}"
}

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: POST items/bulk
item.description: Create multiple items including a nested hierarchy in a single call. Children are nested under their parent in the request tree.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: PATCH items/{id}
item.description: Update an item. Only the fields provided in the body are changed — all other fields remain unchanged.

variable.description: Item ID to update. Defaults to SAMPLE_ITEM_ID — change to the ID of the item you want to modify.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: DELETE items/{id}
item.description: Archive an item (soft delete). Pass cascade=true to also archive all descendants. WARNING: This will archive the item with ID {{SAMPLE_ITEM_ID}} — replace the path variable with the intended item ID before sending.

variable.description: WARNING: Set this to the item you intend to archive. SAMPLE_ITEM_ID is a real item — do not send without changing this.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.
Set to true to also archive all descendants of the item.

item.name: GET snapshot
item.description: Today's planning snapshot for the active stream — returns items scheduled today, due today, and overdue items.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: GET tree
item.description: Full hierarchical item tree for the active stream — all non-archived items as a forest of parent/children nodes.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: GET tree/{id}
item.description: Subtree rooted at the given item ID — returns all descendants of that item as a nested tree.

variable.description: Root item ID for the subtree. Defaults to SAMPLE_ITEM_ID (Startup Archive area — safe read-only).

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: POST capture
item.description: Quick-capture a new todo into the active stream. Creates an item with status=todo. For full control over type/status/parent use POST /items instead.

query.description: Stream ID to scope the request.

item.name: GET search
item.description: Full-text search across item titles, tags, and bodies in the active stream. Use #tag syntax in the query to filter by tag.

query.description: Required. Free-text query. Use #tag to filter by tag, e.g. 'q=design #youtube'.
Stream ID to scope the request.
Filter by status, e.g. 'living' or 'todo,in-progress'.
Filter by item type: task, project, area, or note.
Max results to return.
Pagination offset.
Set to true to include the full markdown body in each result.
